description.en: The ID of the application group.

description.zh:
动态报警规则的云服务类型。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：

- ecs：云服务器ECS。

- rds：关系型数据库。

- slb：负载均衡。
description.en:
The cloud service to which the alert rule is applied. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

- ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)

- rds: ApsaraDB RDS

- slb: Server Load Balancer (SLB)

description.zh:
动态报警规则的组合条件。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：

- and：满足所有报警规则的实例才会自动添加到应用分组。

- or：满足任意报警规则的实例都会自动添加到应用分组。
description.en:
The logical operator used between conditional expressions in the alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

- and: The instances that meet all the conditional expressions are automatically added to the application group.

- or: The instances that meet one of the conditional expressions are automatically added to the application group.

description.zh:
创建动态报警规则的模式。取值：

- true：异步创建。
- false（默认值）：同步创建。
description.en:
The mode for creating the alert rule. Valid values:

- true: creates asynchronously

- false (default): creates synchronously

title.zh: 创建或修改按照实例名称动态匹配的应用分组

example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule --region cn-hangzhou --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Name hostName --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Value nginx --GroupRules.1.Category ecs --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Function contains --IsAsync false --GroupRules.1.FilterRelation and --GroupId 123456
